speaker: S1
text: So, two weeks since we talked. The migration shipped — how did it land?

speaker: S2
text: Smoothly, honestly. Zero rollbacks. The runbook I wrote got reused by the payments team already.

speaker: S1
text: That runbook was excellent. One piece of feedback: in the incident review you jumped to solutions before the timeline was established. It made the room defensive.

speaker: S2
text: That's fair. I get impatient when I already see the fix. I can hold questions until the facts are on the table.

speaker: S2
text: On growth — I want to move toward tech lead. What's actually missing for me?

speaker: S1
text: Scope, mostly. You run projects well; you haven't yet owned a multi-team effort. The search revamp next quarter could be that. It needs a lead and it touches three teams.

speaker: S2
text: I want it. What would you need from me to feel good about it?

speaker: S1
text: A one-page plan: milestones, the cross-team dependencies, and how you'd keep the teams aligned. Bring it to our next one-on-one and I'll take it to staffing.
